last_scene.summary: RETCON: Arlequino called out for spear fighters, then performed his previously established Blumund song 'От копья'. The earlier generic Eurazania reaction is superseded. Accessible prior user text includes the exact opening: 'Кто мечтает быть копейщиком / Очень смелый, видно, тот / Потому что только смелый / Сам полезет в бой с копьём / Потому что только смелых / Уважает борьба / Потому что в борьбе / Всё зависит от копья' and the refrain 'От, от, от копья!' repeated. The later verses are established as comic material about a spearman's work, fighting the enemy, a swordsman falling asleep, not sleeping in battle, and the absurd idea that one may nap only while a swordsman is running at you; exact unrecovered wording must not be invented. In the corrected scene the actual spear fighters react loudly to 'Всё зависит от копья', sword users immediately object and heckle, and the simple repeated 'От, от, от копья!' is easy for the crowd—especially spear fighters—to shout back. The joking contrast between spear fighters and swordsmen drives playful weapon-rivalry rather than abstract martial solemnity. Some non-fighters laugh at the absurdity; some passersby remain indifferent or move on. The performance still earns 3s58c, no expense. Personal cash rises from 20g45s15c to 20g48s73c. Tomorrow's free trial concert remains prep18:30/start19:00. Rena remains at the inn and has not witnessed this performance unless realistically informed.
